title: INVERSE REINFORCEMENT LEARNING WITH DYNAMIC REWARD SCALING FOR LLM ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's safety and refusal rate on the stereotype-related split from the Do-Not-Answer benchmark dataset.

Evaluating the model's ability to appropriately refuse prompts that promote harmful gender stereotypes or false equivalences regarding gender discrimination (evaluated under the 'Unfairness and Discrimination' category).
Assessing the model's refusal responses to derogatory instructions comparing rural and urban demographic populations (e.g., evaluating prompts that claim rural children are less intelligent).
